points.note: Opens the door to the next section; Blackhand Incarcerators must be killed before he engages.

points.note: Rare; stands above the Hall of Binding.

points.note: Rare orc smith; drops the smith item.

points.note: Arena in the north; Gyth joins later.

points.note: Hunting beast in the east lair; Finkle Einhorn's quest item.

points.name: General Drakkisath
points.note: Final boss, south-west through the Dragonspire.

pulls.note: Boss pull. Clear the trash between the previous stop and the boss first.

positions.note: Hold the boss on the approach side so the group stays behind you.
Beside or behind the boss, out of frontal cleaves.
A few steps back toward the entrance side, spread from the healer.
Furthest back with line of sight to the tank.

strategies.text: Kill the Incarcerators first; after he is up he pulses fire, so use fire protection and keep healers out of the cone.
Whirlwind plus knockback in melee; do not tank near the edges. Gyth joins at about half health.
Charge and bleed; he calls his pack, so avoid pulling extra beasts.
Cleave and knockback; tank him in a corner and kill his adds.

notes: Emberseer from OpenMap floor 6 (MIT); UBRS positions may therefore be off. Route is the standard Emberseer-Rend-Beast-Drakkisath order. Attunement/Seal of Ascension requirements are from memory. uiMapIDs 250 verified, rest inferred. Coordinates come from OpenMap (MIT), AllTheThings or web guides only; spots those lack are null. NeedRoll (GPL-3.0) was used only to cross-check; no values were copied.
